preconditions.description: The number of data centers n must be between 2 and 100,000.
The number of clients m must be between 1 and 100,000.
The day length h must be between 2 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= uj < h for uj in u)
preconditions.description: Each maintenance hour uj must be a valid hour within the day length h.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ci1 <= n and 1 <= ci2 <= n and ci1 != ci2 for ci1, ci2 in clients)
preconditions.description: Each client's data center indices must be valid and distinct.

postconditions.description: The output must contain the minimum number of data centers k followed by their indices.

postconditions.expression: len(selected_centers) == k and all(1 <= xi <= n for xi in selected_centers)
postconditions.description: The number of selected data centers must match k, and all indices must be valid.

postconditions.expression: all(u[ci1] != u[ci2] for ci1, ci2 in clients)
postconditions.description: After shifting, no two data centers storing the same client's data must have maintenance at the same hour.
